Class ErrorLogEventSubscriberHandler

public inherited sharing class ErrorLogEventSubscriberHandler
extends TriggerHandler

Trigger handler for ErrorLogEvent__e platform event that converts published error events into persistent ErrorLog__c records.

This handler implements the asynchronous error logging pattern by subscribing to error log platform events and persisting them to the database. The handler extends TriggerHandler to leverage the framework's trigger context management and execution controls.

Key Features:

  • Asynchronous Processing: Executes after platform events are published, decoupling error logging from the originating transaction
  • Partial Success Mode: Uses Database.insert(records, false) to ensure that one malformed event doesn't cause the entire batch to fail
  • Transaction Independence: Error logs are persisted even if the publishing transaction rolls back
  • Bulk Processing: Efficiently handles multiple events in a single trigger execution

Usage:

// Triggered automatically by the ErrorLogEventSubscriber trigger
// when ErrorUtils.publish() is called:
ErrorUtils.log('Error message')
    .withCode('ERROR_CODE')
    .withModule('MyClass.myMethod()')
    .publish();

public override void afterInsert()

Processes ErrorLogEvent__e platform events after they are published and converts them into ErrorLog__c records.

This method executes in the after insert context of the platform event trigger. It iterates through all published events in the trigger context, creates corresponding ErrorLog__c records, and inserts them using partial success mode to ensure fault tolerance.

Implementation Details:

  • Processes all events in Trigger.new
  • Maps event fields (Type__c, Module__c, Code__c, Message__c) to ErrorLog__c fields
  • Uses Database.insert(records, false) for partial success
  • Silently handles individual record failures to prevent batch failure
